notes: The 28 official Pommard Premier Cru climat identities come from the homologated specification. A current BIVB interactive listing additionally surfaces 'Les Perrières' as Pommard Premier Cru, but that name is absent from the homologated 28-name legal list and was not found as a current INAO Pommard Premier Cru product. It is retained separately as a secondary-listing discrepancy and is not legal-claim eligible.
